frames.wavelength_location: Spectral WCS (key W) sampled at the query center (native pixel x=72.95, y=72.71). Other pixels in the image record other wavelengths.
limitations: Display image is nearest-neighbour resampled from ~6.15 arcsec native pixels onto a 256x256 grid of 2.344 arcsec display pixels; it adds no resolution.
Pixels are contrast-stretched for viewing only; no background subtraction; not photometry.
Per-frame stretch: brightness is not directly comparable with other frames.
The quality screen checks flags in a small circle around one position. A clear result is not a detection.
